name: Relic clipboard vault landing page by Relic
description: A warm, paper-toned long-scroll landing page for a clipboard manager, built on cream/beige backgrounds with a signature mustard-yellow accent. Hierarchy comes from pairing a clean grotesque with italic serif accent words ("no place", "Summon it anywhere.") that carry the brand voice through every section heading. Rhythm alternates between full-bleed product screenshots (dark app UI on a yellow gradient card), three-up feature cards, a five-column platform grid, a story timeline, a compact bento of "small things", a dark inverted privacy section, a four-tier pricing row, and an accordion FAQ — so density and background shift every couple of viewports to keep the long scroll fresh. Small mono uppercase section labels (01 CAPTURE, 06 · END-TO-END ENCRYPTED) add editorial structure throughout.
